What if every insect on Earth disappeared?
No more mosquitoes sounds great… but three out of four of our main food crops depend partly on pollinators like bees.
Apples, almonds, coffee and chocolate would become rare and expensive.
We'd still have wheat, rice and corn, because the wind pollinates them. But our plates would get a lot more boring.
Birds, frogs, bats and fish that eat insects would start to starve.
And insects help break down dead plants, dung and bodies. Without them, waste would rot much more slowly, and soil would get poorer.
Which insect would you miss the most? Tell me in the comments.
